notes.title: Seven Days Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33626697/139c3f40d1826800370e01d687296496cf83b29f.png[/img]
[i]Let's play an occult mystery visual novel where all the heroines are dead![/i]

Happy Friday the 13th! We're happy to announce that LIFE0's occult mystery visual novel [b]Seven Days[/b] is now available to play on Steam, with a -10% launch discount until December 21!

Features
[list][*]Full HD graphics
[*]Original art by Miko
[*]Heroines fully voiced by top voice actors
[*]Supports English and Japanese languages[/list]
Japanese voice acting for the game is provided by Uesaka Sumire, Kiritani Choucho,Fujita Masayo, Aranami Kazusa, Shimizu Ai, Shimizu Ayaka, Toda Megumi, Oohashi Ayuru, Maruyama Miki and Urata Wataru.

Further, the game has been updated from its original release in Japan with all-new illustrations thanks to a successful Kickstarter campaign!

[i]Will you be able to grant these seven girls the end they wish for?[/i]

We hope you will enjoy this heartfelt story with us.
